config_loader

Configuration loader for the Virtual Twin system.

Exceptions

ConfigurationError

Raised when configuration is missing or invalid.

Classes

ConfigLoader

Load and validate configuration files.

Module Contents

Bases: Exception

Raised when configuration is missing or invalid.

class config_loader.ConfigLoader[source]

Load and validate configuration files.

static load_config(config_name)[source]

Load a configuration file. FAILS if file doesn’t exist.

Parameters:

config_name (str) – Name of config file (without .yaml)

Returns:

Configuration dictionary

Raises:

ConfigurationError – If config file missing or invalid

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]

static get_required(config, path, error_msg=None)[source]

Get a required configuration value using dot notation.

Parameters:

  • config (Dict) – Configuration dictionary

  • path (str) – Dot-separated path (e.g., “validation.buffer.min_size”)

  • error_msg (Optional[str]) – Custom error message

Returns:

Configuration value

Raises:

ConfigurationError – If path not found
